snippet.title: Harvest Yuuka - Official English Trailer
snippet.description:
Harvest Yuuka is now available on Steam!

Live a quiet life in Gensokyo with Yuuka Kazami in this farming-focused life simulation. Grow seasonal crops, raise animals, fish, hunt, cook, brew potions, and enjoy each day at your own pace.

Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3767620/

Official website:
http://chiyuudou.com/gardensite/

Developer: Chiyuudou
Publisher: Mediascape Co., Ltd.

Harvest Yuuka (Japanese title: 幻想ガーデン物語 ～第一産業 ゆうかりん～) is a fan-made game based on Touhou Project.

©Team Shanghai Alice
©Mediascape Co., Ltd. / Chiyuudou

#HarvestYuuka #TouhouProject #IndieGame
